verdict.rationale: Jan is a locally-run desktop app that runs models fully on-device with privacy/control, builds from source (installs dependencies, builds core components, launches app), and exposes a local OpenAI-compatible API server — all consistent with self-hosting the core product. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of self-hosted deployment (e.g., Docker/server install instructions) and clearer documentation of multi-user/server-mode self-hosting beyond single-user desktop use.
